title: Recover matching Samsung vendor command schemas through offline RIL analysis
acceptance: Analyze an explicitly supplied matching SM-S921B/BYH3 vendor RIL with recorded hashes and a pinned isolated analyzer/toolchain
Separate transport headers from SIM/APDU/registration/PDP/SMS/IMS request and event schemas, preserving uncertainty and unsupported commands
No automatic command replay, device fuzzing, modem reset, profile operation or proprietary binary publication; static inference is not a hardware pass
steps: Review analyzer/runtime requirements and local binary provenance
Perform static extraction and independent checks on synthetic or offline inputs
Version only sanitized schema facts and reproducible analysis reports
